title: feat: Homebrew tap formula and auto-update workflow
body:
Adds infrastructure to distribute memoryweb via Homebrew once the `corbym/homebrew-memoryweb` tap repo is created.

## Changes

- **`Formula/memoryweb.rb`** — Homebrew formula covering macOS (amd64/arm64) and Linux (amd64/arm64), pinned to v1.4.3. Installs the `memoryweb` binary and hooks scripts to `share/memoryweb/hooks/`.
- **`.github/workflows/update-homebrew.yml`** — Triggered on `release: published`. Downloads `checksums.txt` from the new release, extracts the four sha256 values, checks out the tap repo via `HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN`, patches `version` and all `sha256` fields in the formula, then commits and pushes.

## One-time setup required

1. Create `corbym/homebrew-memoryweb` (public repo) with `Formula/memoryweb.rb` copied from this PR.
2. Add a PAT with write access to that repo as secret `HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN` in this repo.

After that, every release tag keeps the tap current automatically. Users install with:

```sh
brew tap corbym/memoryweb
brew install memoryweb
```
